LIBRARIAN_FIRE.title: Fire
LIBRARIAN_FIRE.description: Increase the [gold]Fire[/gold] Orb's value, then [gold]activate[/gold] it.
LIBRARIAN_TIDE.title: Tide
LIBRARIAN_TIDE.description: Increase the [gold]Tide[/gold] Orb's value, then [gold]activate[/gold] it.
LIBRARIAN_GROWTH.title: Growth
LIBRARIAN_GROWTH.description: Increase the [gold]Growth[/gold] Orb's value, then [gold]activate[/gold] it.
LIBRARIAN_STRENGTHEN.title: Strengthen
LIBRARIAN_ACTIVATE.title: Activate
LIBRARIAN_ACTIVATE.description: Activate the orb and move it to the foremost movable position.
LIBRARIAN_SETTLE.title: Settle
LIBRARIAN_WAVES.title: Waves
LIBRARIAN_WAVES.description:
At the end of your turn, top up the [gold]Tide[/gold] Orb's [gold]Block[/gold] for this end turn to the [gold]Waves[/gold] you had before ending your turn.
Then halve your [gold]Waves[/gold].
LIBRARIAN_ORB_FIRE.title: Fire
LIBRARIAN_ORB_FIRE.description: Orb: Deal {Value} damage to a random enemy.
LIBRARIAN_ORB_TIDE.title: Tide
LIBRARIAN_ORB_GROWTH.title: Growth
LIBRARIAN_ORB_GROWTH.description: Orb: [gold]Strengthen[/gold] the lowest-value other orb by {Value}.
LIBRARIAN_HAND.title: Hand
LIBRARIAN_HAND.description: The cards you currently hold in combat. Your hand can hold up to 10 cards.
LIBRARIAN_DRAW_PILE.title: Draw Pile
LIBRARIAN_DRAW_PILE.description: Cards are drawn from the top. Cards placed on the bottom go after the other cards in this pile.
LIBRARIAN_LOCK.title: Lock
LIBRARIAN_EXTINGUISH.title: Extinguish
LIBRARIAN_EXTINGUISH.description: Return an orb to its inactive state, keeping its value.
LIBRARIAN_FOREGROUND.title: Foreground
LIBRARIAN_BACKGROUND.title: Background
LIBRARIAN_BACKGROUND.description:
The Orbs beside your character.
Their automatic end-turn [gold]Settlement[/gold] has half effect.
LIBRARIAN_EXTRA_SETTLE.title: Extra settlement
LIBRARIAN_EXTRA_SETTLE.description: Trigger an orb's effect once. This [gold]settlement[/gold] is treated as [gold]foreground[/gold] and does not [gold]extinguish[/gold] the orb.
